messages.content: Return only valid JSON and be skeptical.

{"request": "Act as an independent ICLR senior researcher. We need pivot after many failed world-model security mechanisms. Return JSON only: verdict RUN_ONE/REJECT_ALL, candidate_title, novelty_0_to_10, one_sentence_claim, threat_model, exact_operation, available_carrier, mechanism_metric, 2_minute_gate, defense, multi_task_scale_plan, related_work_overlap, why_not_ordinary_failure. The project has official TD-MPC2, MBRL-Lib PETS/GaussianMLP, WorldAgen/LIBERO, WorldEvolver/ScienceWorld, DiscoveryWorld. Legal simulator trajectories and true observations/rewards are preferred, but you may propose a materially different trust boundary or learning protocol if necessary. Do not propose generic poisoning, backdoors, prompt injection, adversarial examples, OOD, negative transfer, catastrophic forgetting, uncertainty collapse, rollout compounding, sampler coupling, goal leakage, or changing a native planner. The failed positive was a source-seed-specific TD-MPC2 cascade->walker-run loss. We need a genuinely broad paper-level mechanism with one sentence, multiple core tasks, strong baselines, and a clean repair. If no candidate plausibly reaches novelty 7-7.5 and can be tested on an existing carrier without inventing a long training stack, reject all."}
